deleted = 0
AND module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{module}, '%')
AND operator_username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operator}, '%')
AND operation_type = #{operationType}
AND status = #{status}
AND operated_at >= CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00')
AND operated_at < DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select:
SELECT id, trace_id AS traceId, module, operation_type AS operationType, description, operator_username AS operatorUsername, request_method AS requestMethod, request_url AS requestUrl, request_params AS requestParams, response_result AS responseResult, ip_address AS ipAddress, status, error_message AS errorMessage, duration_ms AS durationMs, operated_at AS operatedAt FROM sys_operation_log
ORDER BY operated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
